statement.zh: Saad 以发掘者综合《The Excavations at Helwan》(Oklahoma 1969 英译本) 公布赫勒万早王朝墓地材料与艺术—文明论述。
statement.en: Saad’s excavator synthesis The Excavations at Helwan (1969 Oklahoma English edition) publishes Helwan Early Dynastic cemetery materials and art-and-civilization discussion.
